This leaves the core motivation of the method somewhat speculative.

Furthermore, the proposed Influence-Aware Energy Regularization (IAER) relies on influence functions, a technique mathematically guaranteed only for convex loss functions. The authors explicitly acknowledge this limitation but treat it casually rather than rigorously validating their approximation. The lack of empirical validation showing that the influence estimates predict actual training outcomes for neural networks is a major flaw. Without this check, IAER appears more of an interesting heuristic than a mathematically grounded method.

Finally, the empirical evaluation lacks statistical rigor.
